About

I'm a researcher and software engineer focused on machine learning, image generation, and intelligent systems.

Background

With a strong foundation in building deep learning frameworks from scratch and data modeling, I specialize in developing scalable products powered by state-of-the-art AI. From writing custom C++ autograd engines to training YOLOv8 models for computer vision, my approach emphasizes both technical depth and practical deployment.

Currently, I'm working as a Research Assistant focusing on image generation technologies. I explore novel generative architectures and optimize inference pipelines. I also hold 4 AWS Certifications, equipping me with the skills to architect and deploy highly available cloud systems.

Approach

I believe that the best ML systems are not just highly accurate, but resilient and efficient. I favor understanding algorithms from first principles, designing strict data schemas, and deploying models with accessible interfaces that hide backend complexity while giving users control.
